# Support

Need help with Kyberion? This page describes how to get support for this public open-source repository.

## Where to ask

- **Bug reports** — open an issue using the [bug report template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.md).
- **Feature requests** — open an issue using the [feature request template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md).
- **First contribution questions** — start from the [good first issue guide](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/good-first-issue-guide.md).
- **Community overview** — see [`docs/COMMUNITY.md`](../docs/COMMUNITY.md) for the channels and norms of the community.

## How to file a good report

- **Bug**: include reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and your environment (`pnpm doctor` output helps). Use the [bug template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.md) — it prompts for all of these.
- **Feature**: describe the problem you are trying to solve before proposing a solution. Use the [feature template](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.md).

## Contributing and community standards

- Contribution workflow and review expectations: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Community standards: [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- Environment setup: [`docs/INITIALIZATION.md`](../docs/INITIALIZATION.md) and [`docs/QUICKSTART.md`](../docs/QUICKSTART.md)
- Starter tasks: [`docs/developer/GOOD_FIRST_ISSUES.md`](../docs/developer/GOOD_FIRST_ISSUES.md)

## Security issues

**Never** report a security issue through a public issue. Follow the process in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).
